name: vanessa
description: Scenario UI testing via Vanessa Automation: plays Gherkin feature files against a running infobase and reports which scenario step failed and why (+ failure screenshots). Complements yaxunit_tests (code from the inside) by driving the UI from the outside. Pass featurePath (a .feature file or a directory of them) and projectName - the infobase the project is bound to is the one played against, or connectionString to name another. Or compose the action right here: listKind with listName opens the list, column with columnValue goes to the row, buttonTitle or buttonName presses the form's button, and the window it opens is waited for (windowWaitSeconds). The frame is the top window of the test client, saved by the VanessaExt add-in, so it shows that window whatever covers it. On a list action and on formToOpen, testManager and testClient are turned on when left out, and false is refused: the start step then activates the client that opens the infobase of the run. Requires vanessa-automation.epf and the 1C thick client (1cv8.exe) configured in EDT preferences (download from github.com/Pr-Mex/vanessa-automation). Waits for the run and answers when it ends; async=true answers with a runKey instead, which comes back for the result and also cancels the run. Raise timeoutSeconds for long suites. A timeout held by a 1C window returns that window as blockingWindows, with its title, texts, buttons and imageFile, and does not ask to raise timeoutSeconds.

featurePath.description: Path to a .feature file or a directory of feature files. Required to start a run unless scenarioText is given; a call that carries a runKey takes neither. A relative path is resolved against the project when projectName is given.

scenarioText.description: The scenario itself in place of a file: Gherkin text written to the run's own temporary directory and played from there. For a caller that reaches this server over MCP and has no way to put a file on the machine - a form in a running 1C is photographed by a scenario that opens it and captures. The step wording is Vanessa's own and differs between its versions, so it is yours to give, the same way the vanessaParams names are. Given together with featurePath, both are refused.

formToOpen.description: The form to open and photograph, in the words the opening step expects - a common form's name, a catalog's FQN, whatever the step takes. The scenario is composed from it, so neither featurePath nor scenarioText is passed with it. The frame is the top window of the test client, drawn into the file by the add-in, whatever covers that window.

openStep.description: The step that opens the form, with {form} where the name goes. Defaults to opening a common form. A list form, an object form and an extension's form are opened by different words, and the words belong to Vanessa and differ between its versions, so pass the one your library uses.

startStep.description: The step that gets a client to work in. Defaults to launching TestClient or attaching to one already running.

listKind.description: Metadata kind of the list the scenario opens, one of: catalog, document, documentJournal, chartOfCharacteristicTypes, chartOfAccounts, chartOfCalculationTypes, informationRegister, accumulationRegister, accountingRegister, calculationRegister.

listName.description: Name of the metadata object whose list form the scenario opens.

tableName.description: Name of the list's table on the form the steps address (default Список).

column.description: Caption of the column the row to act on is found by.

columnValue.description: Value of that column; an empty string is a value and is looked for as empty.

whenSeveral.description: When several rows carry the value: unique (default) demands exactly one before moving, first moves to the first of them.

buttonTitle.description: Title of the form's button to press - exactly one of buttonTitle and buttonName.

buttonName.description: Name of the form's button to press - exactly one of buttonTitle and buttonName.

windowTitle.description: Title of the window the button is expected to open; without it the run waits for a window whose title differs from the one before the click.

windowWaitSeconds.description: Seconds the step that waits for the window waits (default 10).

connectionString.description: 1C infobase connection string, e.g. 'File="C:\\ib";' or 'Srvr="host";Ref="base";'. Omitted, the infobase the named project is bound to is used - EDT knows it already. A server infobase has to be named here. A Pwd is refused: it would reach the client as a command-line argument, readable by every process on the machine. Use an infobase that needs no password, or one that accepts the operating system's authentication. A call that carries a runKey does not take it.

async.description: Hand back a runKey instead of waiting out the run. Come back with that runKey for the result, or with runKey and cancel=true to stop the client.

runKey.description: The key from a Pending reply: comes back for that run rather than starting one.

cancel.description: With runKey: stops the client and its worker processes. What the scenarios already wrote to the infobase stays written.

waitSeconds.description: With runKey: how long to wait this time before answering Pending again.

vanessaParams.description: Optional JSON object of Vanessa parameters to add to VAParams.json, for filtering by tag or by scenario name among other things. The names are Vanessa's own and differ between its versions, so they are yours to give; it ignores one it does not know. The few this tool reads its result back from are refused.

projectName.description: Optional EDT project name - used to resolve a relative featurePath and as the working directory.

timeoutSeconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the run (default 300, max 3600).

infobaseUser.description: Name of the 1C user the run signs in as. A base with users defined meets a client that names none with a login window, and the run then waits out its whole deadline. A password cannot be passed here.

testManager.description: Start the client as a test manager (default true). The UI-testing types a form-driving scenario needs exist only in a client started this way; without it such a step answers Тип не определен. On a list action and on formToOpen, left out means on, and false is refused.

vanessaExt.description: Enable VanessaExt for any input mode. Omitted: enabled for composed form/list actions, unchanged for file/text. Composed actions refuse false; enabling does not prove the add-in is installed.

testClient.description: Name a test client in VAParams for the start step to launch (default false). The step that starts TestClient has no client to start without it and answers with an empty client type and PID 0. On a list action and on formToOpen, left out means on, and false is refused.

testClientPort.description: Port the test client listens on (default 48010). Name another when a second run or another EDT already holds it.

screenshots.description: Capture a screenshot on step failure (default true).

keepOpen.description: Leave the 1C client open after the run to watch it (default false). Note: a kept-open client will time out here since it never exits.
